title: Sharpened Discrete Min-Cut Recurrences, Conflict-Chromatic Omega(1/d^2) Flexibility, and Universal Mutual-Exclusion Gadgets for d-Degenerate List Coloring
abstract: Advancing Adak et al. (arXiv:2611.34348v1), we prove four new structural, probabilistic, and extremal theorems on flexible list coloring of d-degenerate graphs: (1) a Sharpened Discrete Min-Cut Recurrence and Pade Shift Theorem eliminating double-counting of r(u_j) in Claim 9 via p - 1/M <= (1 - 1/M)p, yielding the exact discrete criterion (d + 2 - 1/M)(1 - (1 - 1/M)^max(0, d-k+S+M)) <= S for all S in {1..d} and Pade shift -ln(1 - 1/M) < 1/(M - 1/2 - 1/(6M)), lowering the sub-2d crossover for optimal ratio epsilon = 1/(d+1) from d >= 9 to d >= 8 (k = 15 < 16), strictly improving min(2d, floor((d+2)(2-1/e))) on 50/93 (53.8%) of integers d in [8, 100], and extending to weighted requests; (2) a Generalized s-Rank Global Palette-Order Theorem proving weighted (d + 1 + s, s / (chi(H_r)(1 + d(d+s))))-flexibility for monochromatic conflict subgraph H_r, recovering Adak et al. Theorem 1 at s=1 and jumping to Omega(1/d^2) for bounded-conflict requests (chi(H_r) = O(1)); (3) a Universal All-d Mutual-Exclusion Family G_d on 2d+3 vertices with (d+1)-lists and 4 requests satisfying at most 1 request for every d >= 2; and (4) a Sharp Forest Double-Optimum Theorem constructively proving every forest is weighted (2, 1/2)-flexible and characterizing (2 - 1/e)d as the exact asymptotic barrier of the Properties 3-4 flow method. Formalized with 20 Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 custom axioms), zero-float exact-Q/Z verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates, and 73 passing adversarial tests.
